result.summary: The street environment is hostile to pedestrians, characterized by a complete lack of formal sidewalks, curbs, or marked crossings. Pedestrians are forced to walk on unpaved, uneven dirt shoulders or directly in the roadway alongside vehicular traffic.

hazards.name: Lack of Sidewalks
hazards.description: There are no paved walkways on either side of the street, forcing pedestrians into the roadway or onto uneven dirt shoulders.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the roadway throughout the visible block

hazards.name: Absence of Lane Markings
hazards.description: The lack of center lines or edge lines can lead to unpredictable vehicle positioning, increasing risk for pedestrians sharing the space.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and edges of the asphalt roadway

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the left shoulder block sight lines between drivers and pedestrians who may be walking or attempting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the road where white and red vehicles are parked

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct continuous, ADA-compliant concrete sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide physical separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Curb and Gutter Construction
interventions.description: Install vertical curbs to clearly define the roadway edge and prevent vehicles from encroaching onto pedestrian areas.

interventions.title: Roadway Striping
interventions.description: Apply high-visibility lane markings to organize traffic flow and define the travel lanes.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a severely degraded walkway adjacent to a large vacant lot enclosed by temporary fencing. There is a complete lack of pedestrian infrastructure, such as lighting, buffers, or marked crossings, creating a hostile and neglected streetscape.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: The walkway surface is heavily cracked and uneven, presenting significant tripping hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground across the entire width of the paved area

hazards.name: Walkway Obstruction
hazards.description: The concrete bases of the temporary chain-link fence protrude into the walking path.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the line of the temporary fence

hazards.name: Lack of Natural Surveillance
hazards.description: The blank frontage of the vacant lot and lack of street lighting create a desolate environment with no 'eyes on the street'.
hazards.location_in_image: Background and midground

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Replace the degraded pavement with a smooth, ADA-compliant concrete sidewalk.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Installation
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and personal security.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add a planting strip with trees to provide a buffer from the roadway and improve the aesthetic quality of the walk.

result.summary: The street environment exhibits a significant disparity in pedestrian infrastructure, with a functional brick sidewalk on the residential side and a degraded, fenced-off walkway on the opposite side. The lack of marked crossings and lane markings on the relatively wide roadway creates a hostile environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Degraded Walkway
hazards.description: The walkway on the left side of the image is unpaved, narrow, and partially obstructed by a chain-link fence.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the roadway along the fence line

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks visible, requiring pedestrians to cross an unmarked roadway with no designated right-of-way.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the entire width of the roadway

hazards.name: Blank Frontage
hazards.description: The long stretch of chain-link fence and vacant lot creates a lack of 'eyes on the street,' reducing perceived safety and comfort.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Install a continuous, paved, and ADA-compliant sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide a safe walking surface.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint high-visibility crosswalks at the nearest intersections to clearly define pedestrian crossing points.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Plant street trees to provide shade, improve aesthetics, and create a physical buffer between pedestrians and vehicles.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a narrow, poorly maintained brick walkway obstructed by debris and a leaning tree. The lack of street lighting, clear lane markings, and the presence of blank, graffiti-covered walls create a hostile and neglected atmosphere for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Debris and dumping
hazards.description: A mattress and other large items are blocking the walkway on the right side of the image.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the walkway

hazards.name: Leaning tree
hazards.description: A large tree is leaning significantly over the walkway, potentially obstructing passage and creating a head-height hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-right of the image

hazards.name: Lack of lighting
hazards.description: No street lights are visible, which would make this area very dark and unsafe at night.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the scene

interventions.title: Walkway Clearance and Maintenance
interventions.description: Remove the dumped mattress and debris to restore the full width of the walkway.

interventions.title: Install Street Lighting
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and personal security.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Replace the narrow, uneven brick path with a wider, ADA-compliant concrete sidewalk and a proper curb.
